concept: Back-street bookmaker: wiry, quick and flash. Slicked-back hair, thin moustache, trilby hat, red pinstripe three-piece suit, gold chain and rings, pencil behind his ear, two-tone brogues. Keeps his distance and flicks throwing knives, side-steps your attacks, then snaps in with a high kick.

generator.mode: PixelLab v3, 96px canvas, side view, facing right, native size (set target_height to the base's real height, scale 1.0). Generate the base in the fighting stance and use it as the start frame for every animation.
generator.prompt: wiry flash back-street bookmaker, slicked-back hair, thin moustache, black trilby hat, red pinstripe three-piece suit, gold watch chain and rings, pencil behind his ear, two-tone brogues, light on his feet in a fighting stance, full body, detailed 32-bit pixel art, clean dark outline

animation_notes.throw: flicks a throwing knife forward from shoulder height
animation_notes.dodge: quick backstep away, light and nimble

walk.note: raw/pixellab/walk frames 1-8 (0 is the stance start frame)

windup.note: raw/pixellab/kick frames 1-2: the start of the knee chamber, held over the 0.33 s windup_time (given here so the importer doesn't trim it from the kick)

kick.note: raw/pixellab/kick frames 3-8: chamber, snap out (frame 5 hits), recover. 0.4 s with the hit at 0.13-0.2 s, the old kick's timing

hurt.note: raw/pixellab/knockdown frames 1-2-3-2-1: the backward stagger before the fall (the v3 hurt crouched instead of recoiling)

getup.note: raw/pixellab/getup frames 1-10; generated from knockdown frame 10 to the stance, 132x128 cropped 2 px each side back to the shared 128x128 canvas

throw_windup.note: raw/pixellab/throw frames 1-5: draws the knife back to his shoulder (0.33 s, the throw windup)

throw.note: raw/pixellab/throw frames 6-8: the release and follow-through after the knife leaves (0.27 s)

dodge.note: raw/pixellab/dodge frames 1-5: the backstep (the game slides him back 0.23 s)
